SUBJECT: Professional Services Agreement with DTS for Pavement Condition Survey.
The following is in support of why Staff has selected DTS for data collection services for the
above project.DTS was determined as the most qualified firm for the Pavement Condition
Survey Project.The selection process determined that DTS stood out as the best firm with
experience, technical expertise and overall professional integrity giving the City and its residents
the best product possible.
In the summerof 2018the City will be looking tofully collect the condition of all the roadways
in Cheyenne.In addition to road condition, curb and gutter condition will also be collected. The
City has not completed a street condition survey since 2014.There is no existing curb and gutter
condition information currently.The Pavement Condition Survey project will give the City of
Cheyenne an opportunity tolook at the existing road infrastructure andgive the City abetter
picture on how to improve the overall pavement condition index(PCI) of the roads.The main
intent to this project is to collect the current PCIof all the streets and condition of the curb and
gutter. To address this need for data collection a plan was required. A Request for Proposal was
drafted and advertised.In response to the RFP six proposals were submitted to the City.The
engineering firms are as follows: DTS, PERTAN, SEH, IMS, Terracon and Black Pearl Asphalt.
After reviewing the six proposals submitted, three firmswere selected for interviews.The top
three firms that were selected are DTS, SEH and PERTAN. The interviews were conducted, and
the scoreswere tallied, resulting inDTSbeing selectedas the highest scoring firm.Insummary,
DTS scored higher thanSEH andPERTANin applicable experience, innovations, technical
expertise, adequate resources, and equitable distribution ofwork.Aunanimous decision was
rendered with all of the selection committee choosing DT S.
It should benoted that Staff feels that DTSprevious experience with street data collection and
processing of many other communities was an aspect that the other firms werelacking.Also,
their ability to collect and follow theASTM D6433 standards with an automated system set them
apart from the rest of the firms. This previous experience and knowledge would be advantageous

could be taken into consideration during thedata collection.This should result infewer problems

At the conclusion of the interviews DTS was selected as the topfirm for the project based on the
established criteria.The estimated fees submitted by DTS were opened at that time and was
found to be close to the anticipated amount. This amount was S124,820.00.
In summary Staff recommends that the professional services agreement for the Pavement
Condition Survey project be awarded to DTS in the amount of $124,820.00.
